workflow.name: Zynx Developer Mode Build
workflow.goal: Convert Zynx ecosystem concepts into repo-backed implementation slices, validate the workflow route map, and produce a human-reviewable build report.

agents.name: Zynx Orchestrator
agents.role: Coordinate developer-mode implementation from concept to repo-backed plan

agents.name: Task Planner
agents.role: Break the Zynx concept stack into buildable implementation slices

agents.name: Schema Validator
agents.role: Validate workflow JSON, route mappings, and artifact references

agents.name: Code Generator
agents.role: Identify the smallest next source change required to replace backend stubs

agents.name: Code Reviewer
agents.role: Review implementation risk, security boundaries, and overclaiming risk

agents.name: Test Generator
agents.role: Define verification commands for build, workflow dry-run, and governance checks

agents.name: Doc Writer
agents.role: Write developer-facing plan, pitch deck, and launch-safe positioning

agents.name: Report Generator
agents.role: Generate a run report that separates Done, In Progress, and Planned capabilities

agents.name: Logger
agents.role: Append audit-friendly notes and preserve source-of-truth boundaries
